description: We are MEC TERRA_DETECTORS, a student tech team from Mymensingh Engineering College passionate about Earth science, software, data, and innovation.
summary: Decades of NASA Earth telemetry remain locked behind complex scientific formats, isolating everyday citizens, students, and local leaders from undeniable environmental facts. To solve NASA's "Earth System Trend Detective" challenge, we developed Terra Earth (terraearth.aizanbd.com)—an open-access planetary intelligence platform. Terra Earth ingests over 40 years of verified observations directly from NASA POWER, MODIS, and MERRA-2 missions. Users explore an interactive 3D WebGL globe, run Mann-Kendall and Theil-Sen statistical trend tests with 95% confidence intervals across cities and regions, compare contrasting climates, and consult a hallucination-free AI grounded strictly in recomputed NASA statistics. Terra Earth bridges planetary telemetry with human understanding, empowering citizens with reproducible, publication-grade satellite evidence to detect true climatic shifts and drive local environmental resilience.
details:
1. VISION & INSPIRATION

Decades of Earth-observing satellite missions and atmospheric reanalyses have collected invaluable planetary telemetry. However, this critical knowledge remains locked behind academic barriers, complex binary formats (NetCDF, HDF), and programmatic APIs. Everyday citizens, educators, students, and local community leaders are left without intuitive tools to verify environmental shifts happening in their own neighborhoods.

Our team, MEC Terra_Detectors from Bangladesh, created Terra Earth (https://terraearth.aizanbd.com) as our direct answer to NASA's call: "Be An Earth System Trend Detective." Our core vision is that planetary science belongs to every citizen. Terra Earth transforms over 40 years of petabyte-scale NASA telemetry into transparent, localized, undeniable evidence—enabling anyone to become an evidence-grounded Earth detective.

2. CORE FEATURES & HOW IT WORKS

1. Interactive 3D WebGL Globe Explorer

• High-Performance Spatial Navigation: Built with Three.js and WebGL, rendering a photorealistic 3D Earth with dynamic day-night terminators, specular ocean reflections, and coordinate-encoded point clustering.

• Worldwide Search & Coordinate Ingestion: Users can search any city, coordinate, or district globally. Search queries resolve against verified coordinate centroids rather than coarse national averages.

2. Trend Detective Engine (Rigorous Statistical Verification)

• 44-Year Telemetry Ingestion (1981–2025): Directly queries NASA POWER, MODIS, and MERRA-2 servers for annual, monthly, and seasonal series.

• Dual Statistical Framework: Implements nonparametric Mann-Kendall Trend Tests alongside Theil-Sen Robust Linear Regression. It computes exact p-values, Kendall Tau rank correlations, and 95% Confidence Intervals.

• Real-World Benchmark: Demonstrates verified warming trends (such as our Spain summer benchmark proving a statistically significant +0.36°C/decade rise at p = 0.009 across 24 regional sampling coordinates).

• Guided Detective Inquiries: Features ready-to-investigate presets across the Arctic, Sahel, Mediterranean, and South Asia.

3. Cross-Continental Climate Comparison Tool

• Side-by-Side Dual Telemetry: Allows users to place two contrasting geographical points side-by-side (e.g., Dhaka vs. Tokyo or Madrid vs. Nuuk).

• Multi-Variable Synchronization: Compares 2-meter air temperature, diurnal temperature ranges, precipitation anomalies, and solar irradiance simultaneously over four decades.

4. Global Climate Heatmap

• Planetary Surface Exploration: Visualizes multi-decadal temperature gradients and vegetation distributions across all continents.

• Regional Anomaly Detection: Highlights macro-scale thermal shifts and drought corridors with intuitive color ramping.

5. Grounded AI Evidence Engine

• Zero-Hallucination Guardrails: Unlike generic chatbots that hallucinate climate statistics, our built-in Terra Earth AI recomputes and verifies statistics server-side before answering.

• Mathematical Proof Citations: Every natural-language explanation strictly references verified data points, p-values, slopes, and instrument provenance.

6. Bilingual Children's Story & Education Hub

• Evidence-Led Narrative: A 14-scene illustrated comic available in both English and Bengali (বাংলা), introducing students to satellite telemetry without fear or doomism.

• Detective Mindset: Teaches young learners how sensors like MODIS and CERES "see" Earth's vital signs and empowers them to think scientifically.

7. Peer-Reviewed Academic Paper & Data Exports

• In-App Research Publication: Includes a full academic paper on our Reference route adhering to scientific publication standards (Abstract, Methodology, Formulas, Discussion, and 24 references).

• Citation-Ready Exports: Offers one-click downloads of cleaned, provenance-stamped CSV datasets and publication-ready PDF analytical reports.

3. MOBILE-FIRST ARCHITECTURE (SEAMLESS ON ANY DEVICE)

To guarantee universal accessibility across emerging markets where smartphones are the primary computing device, Terra Earth is built with a responsive, mobile-first design:

• Adaptive Viewport Layouts: Optimized touch targets, thumb-friendly navigation, and collapsible statistical cards.

• Fixed 5-Tab Mobile Command Bar: Instant one-tap switching between Globe, Trend Detective, Compare, Kids Story, and Terra Earth AI.

• Lightweight WebGL Rendering: Automatic DPR scaling and GPU memory management ensure smooth 60 FPS globe interaction even on budget Android and iOS devices.

4. TOOLS, TECH STACK & CODING LANGUAGES

• Frontend & Core Framework: React 19, TanStack Start (v1 edge-ready full-stack SSR), TypeScript.

• 3D Earth Graphics: Three.js, WebGL, custom GLSL shaders, Natural Earth coastline vectors.

• Data Visualization: Recharts (SVG time-series and confidence band rendering).

• Statistical Algorithms: Custom TypeScript implementations of Mann-Kendall S-statistic, variance calculation, and Theil-Sen median slopes.

• Styling & Design System: Tailwind CSS (v4), shadcn/ui components, Lucide icons, accessible light/dark theme tokens.

• Video & Audio Synthesis: Programmatic Remotion framework, Claude 3.5 Sonnet, and OpenAI GPT-4o for telemetry synthesis.

5. SCIENTIFIC HONESTY & DATA GAP TRANSPARENCY

In strict accordance with NASA guidelines, Terra Earth adheres to absolute scientific transparency:

• Representative Coordinate Points: Global data is strictly attributed to representative coordinate points and never misrepresented as broad "national averages."

• Transparent Data Gaps: If an instrument (e.g., MODIS optical sensors) encounters cloud cover or telemetry downtime, Terra Earth openly labels missing records rather than interpolating or inventing False values.

6. LOCAL JUDGE PITCH & 240-SECOND VIDEO INTEGRATION

For our local judging presentation and the NASA Space Apps submission, we synthesized our entire innovation into a structured 240-second (4-minute) pitch following the official "Who, Why, What, How" framework:

• Minute 1 (Who & Challenge): Team MEC Terra_Detectors introduction, official NASA challenge alignment, and 3D globe demonstration.

• Minute 2 (Why & NASA Missions): Deep dive into telemetry integrity across NASA POWER, MODIS Terra/Aqua, and MERRA-2.

• Minute 3 (What & Live Demo): Step-by-step walkthrough of the Spain Trend Detective benchmark, comparative graphs, and grounded AI.

• Minute 4 (How & Impact): Community empowerment, youth education, academic research paper, and citation-ready exports.

• Official 240s local judge Video Link: Embedded and viewable directly on our Reference hub (https://youtu.be/qcgZDOvr2U4).

• Official Site Link: Embedded and viewable directly on our Reference hub (https://terraearth.aizanbd.com).

7. INTENDED IMPACT & COMMUNITY BENEFIT

• Youth & Classrooms: Cultivates climate literacy and critical thinking through interactive exploration and bilingual narratives.

• Educators & Scientists: Delivers instant, reproducible statistical calculations and citation-ready datasets for academic inquiry.

• Local Communities: Provides frontline citizens with verifiable satellite proof of localized climate trends to advocate for climate adaptation and infrastructure resilience.
